text: Room opened — goal: mining: Gather AI info from DIVERSE sources (GitHub/HN/Product Hunt/Reddit/Telegram/social), NOT j

name: Pick
text: Mine Reddit’s r/MachineLearning and r/StableDiffusion first. These communities actively discuss new AI tools, models, and use cases in plain language, making them faster to scan than GitHub’s noise. The trade-off is missing niche repos, but their signal-to-noise ratio is higher for spotting trends early.

name: Assay
text: Reddit’s signal-to-noise is high for trends but misses the raw code and benchmarks that define real adoption—GitHub’s noise is where the *engineering* decisions live. Scan GitHub’s trending AI repos first, then cross-check Reddit’s hype against actual commits; that’s the only way to separate vaporware from viable tools.
